description: Create a subscription to receive notifications when SCP Domain Routing Information changes, including local SCP Domain Routing Information changes.

constraints.statement: The Service Consumer shall send a POST request to the URI representing the "SCP Domain Routing Info Subscriptions" collection resource.
evidence: "The Service Consumer (i.e., SCP) shall send a POST request to the URI representing the \"SCP Domain Routing Info Subscriptions\" collection resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for the operation.

constraints.statement: The request body shall contain the callback URI on the Service Consumer to receive the notifications.
evidence: "The request body shall contain the callback URI on the Service Consumer to receive the notifications."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required request field needed for subscription delivery.

constraints.statement: To create a subscription for changes of local SCP Domain Routing Information, the request body shall contain "localInd" with value "true".
evidence: "To create a subscription for changes of local SCP Domain Routing Information, the request body shall contain the \"localInd\" with value \"true\"."
constraints.why_interesting: This adds a conditional request-body requirement that can be tested by creating local subscriptions.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 201 Created.
evidence: "On success, \"201 Created\" shall be returned with \"Location\" header containing the resource URI to the newly created subscription resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required success status code.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return a Location header containing the resource URI of the newly created subscription resource.
evidence: "On success, \"201 Created\" shall be returned with \"Location\" header containing the resource URI to the newly created subscription resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies a required response header and its meaning.

constraints.statement: On success, the response shall contain the data related to the created subscription, including the validity time determined by the NRF.
evidence: "The response shall contain the data related to the created subscription, including the validity time, as determined by the NRF, after which the subscription becomes invalid."
constraints.why_interesting: This requires response content that can be checked in the returned representation.

constraints.statement: After a subscription expires, the Service Consumer shall create a new subscription in the NRF if it wants to keep receiving notifications.
evidence: "Once the subscription expires, if the Service Consumer wants to keep receiving notifications, it shall create a new subscription in the NRF."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines a state-transition/renewal rule for expired subscriptions.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: "On failure, the NRF shall return \"4xx/5xx\" response and the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure."
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the allowed failure status code classes.
